title: Warm Buttery Moroccan Vegetables Couscous Royal
description: A kid-friendly Moroccan dish featuring roasted vegetables and slow-cooked couscous, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This buttery and snappy dish is sure to please the whole family.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped carrots, zucchini, and red bell pepper with 2 tablespoons of butter, salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a boil.
Add the couscous to the pot, cover, and turn off the heat.
Let the couscous sit for 5 minutes, then fluff it with a fork.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the couscous and stir until it is melted and the couscous is well coated.
To serve, divide the couscous among individual plates, then top with the roasted vegetables.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
